description:
Rank Warsaw neighborhoods for two people who work in two places (para, dwa biura): median rent, both commutes and
monthly_cost (rent + both commutes valued at the minimum wage). Each person can use a different mode. Neighborhoods with
fewer than 20 ads are skipped.

max_commute_min.description: Max commute minutes for each person
max_commute_min.title: Max Commute Min

mode_a.description: transit (default, weekday morning public transport + walking), bike, walk or car (rush hour) / komunikacja, rower, pieszo, auto
mode_a.title: Mode A

mode_b.description: transit (default, weekday morning public transport + walking), bike, walk or car (rush hour) / komunikacja, rower, pieszo, auto
mode_b.title: Mode B

rooms.description: Rooms 1-4 (4 = 4+); omit for any / liczba pokoi
rooms.title: Rooms

sort.description: best = rent + both commutes valued at the minimum wage (default); fair = shortest longer commute first; rent = cheapest first
sort.title: Sort

name: rank_for_two
